answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on a progressive ledge of mutual attestations. Each identity must gather a slow zephyr of verified reciprocal work across epochs before rewards unlock. An attacker flooding clones faces the concrete cost of continuously feeding a nectar-rich cluster of genuine interactions; sparse or artificial graphs are scored zero by the jury. One-time key creation is cheap, sustained authentic peer verification is the scarce resource that prices out mass fakes.
